newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 30.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 30. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Tirtamas group chief Hashim Djojohaidkusumo said there has been no misuse of position by his brother-in-law central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono after Tirtamas purchased a number of banks, includings its most recent acquisition of Bank Niaga.
Central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said Bank Indonesia had sold $1 billion in the forward market to stabilise the rupiah after a recent run on the currency by foreign speculators.

Indonesia's special ambassador on East Timor Lopez Da Cruz said that South African President Nelson Mandela had not asked that jailed East Timorese resistance leader Xanana Gusmao be freed during a recent trip to Indonesia.
The country's air force chief-of-staff Air Marshall Sutria Tubagus said Indonesia expects to buy up to 20 Russian fighter jets before the end of this year.
